title: Minimum Swaps To Make Sequences Increasing
goal: Use the fewest same-index swaps so both sequences become strictly increasing.
strategy: Keep two costs for each index: leave this pair in place or swap it. Straight comparisons preserve the previous swap status; cross comparisons allow changing that status.
